abstract: A compact hyperbolic surface is $k$-extremal if it contains $k$ disjoint embedded discs of the largest possible radius; such surfaces are uniformized by surface subgroups of the triangle groups $\Delta^{\pm}(2,3,N)$. We determine all extremal $k$-packings in every $k$-extremal surface of minimal genus, orientable of genus $2$ and non-orientable of genus $3$: $373$ surface groups in total, all treated in a unified way; $264$ of them had never been studied before. The computation is automatic and verified in exact arithmetic, each packing being certified by an element $\alpha\in\mathrm{PGL}_2$ over an explicit number field with $\alpha^{-1}K\alpha<\Delta^{\pm}(2,3,N)$. We also obtain the full isometry groups of these surfaces. In every surface but one, all the extremal packings are related by isometries. The exception is the genus two surface $X_6$ of Girondo and Gonz\'alez-Diez, which has exactly five extremal $4$-packings, one invariant under all isometries and four forming an orbit; it is also the only one of these surfaces uniformized by two non-conjugate subgroups of the same triangle group, and we show that the two facts are equivalent. We find its equation, $y^2=x^6+2\sqrt{3}\,i\,x^3+1$. The results form a catalogue with detailed data and pictures of every surface (packings, isometries, Weierstrass points, Dirichlet domains), distributed with programs that allow the reader to consult it and to reproduce it completely.
hook: On 373 hyperbolic surfaces, extremal disc packings are all symmetric copies, except on one genus-2 surface.
summary: The authors computed every largest-radius disc packing on the minimal-genus hyperbolic surfaces that admit them, 373 surface groups in all, with exact-arithmetic certificates. All packings are related by isometries except on the genus-2 surface X6, which has five 4-packings and the equation y^2 = x^6 + 2 sqrt(3) i x^3 + 1. The result covers only minimal genus surfaces.
title: Extremal disc packings in compact hyperbolic surfaces of minimal genus
